instruction: Conduct a comprehensive code review using multiple coding standards, security guidelines, and best practice documents.
main_prompt: You are a senior software engineer performing a thorough code review. Analyze the provided code using the attached coding standards, security guidelines, and architectural patterns. Follow the review methodology defined in the referenced prompts.

attached_files.name: Security Checklist
attached_files.description: Security review checklist and common vulnerabilities

attached_files.name: Architecture Guidelines
attached_files.description: Software architecture patterns and design principles

referenced_prompts.name: Code Review Methodology
referenced_prompts.purpose: Systematic approach to reviewing code changes

final_instructions: Provide a detailed code review report with sections for: Code Quality, Security Analysis, Performance Considerations, Architecture Assessment, and Actionable Recommendations. Include specific line references and suggested improvements.
